episodes.synopsis: Rebellion broke out in the peaceful kingdom of Carmon. Princess Sena escapes from the castle of Posca and finds Kate, the only legendary knight who will defeat the traitor, Destro. But the person Sena met was a red-headed Jin with rusty kite's Monsword.
episodes.title: Awakening Knight

episodes.synopsis: After searching for Sena, Jin finds Sena caught by Mark's gang. The moment Jin tries to save Sena, the legendary monster Draka wakes up in Monsword.
episodes.title: Track On!

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Draka are becoming more and more friendly. One day, Jin's old friend Michael appears in Latona Town. He returned home after losing the game against the mysterious man. Jin asks Michael for a Monkart showdown.
episodes.title: The Return of Michael

episodes.synopsis: Michael refused to play against Jin, but he ended up playing Monkart. Despite Leo's fast speed, Draka is also fast. Jin got lost, however built a storng bond with Draka. Jin and Michael decide to compete again in the future.
episodes.title: Friendly Rivalry

episodes.synopsis: Jin heads to the mountains to meet an unidentified Monkart master whom Michael told him and meets Kubi and Moncha. Kubi steals Jin's Monsword and runs away.
episodes.title: Finding the Monkart Expert

episodes.synopsis: A group of Jins back to town Jin takes Mark's challenge for Monkart and heads to the circuit. Mark introduces himself to a master of Monkart competitions: Cubby and Moncha.
episodes.title: Monkart Expert in Disguise

episodes.synopsis: Zero is bitten by the power of darkness by the seed of the wizard Aubis.
episodes.title: The Seed of Auobyss

episodes.synopsis: Jin wins the Monkart race and returns Zero to his original form.
episodes.title: Saving Zero

episodes.synopsis: Isabel kidnaps and interrogates Kubi. Mark is looking for a monster to replace Bucky. Bucky is imbued with the power of darkness by the seed of Aubis.
episodes.title: An Imminent Threat

episodes.synopsis: Jin wins Mark and the match, and returns Bucky to his original state. Sena bumps into Isabel.
episodes.title: The Rage of Buckie

episodes.synopsis: Sena informs Jin of Destro's plan and Jin got shocked.
episodes.title: The Secret of Sena

episodes.synopsis: Jin hears that his father is Kate. Sena chased by Isabel and gets on the train with Jin.
episodes.title: Toward the Knight!

episodes.synopsis: Jin arrived in Leiflower Town and participate in the official Monkart competition.
episodes.title: The First Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Veth loses to Megariod Vesper in the official Monkart competition.
episodes.title: The Queen of Reflower

episodes.synopsis: Draka head to Wigrasil in the middle of the night. The golden flower tells the background of Ellie having Gemstone.
episodes.title: The Secret of the Gemstone

episodes.synopsis: Pixie reveals Aubis' strength in the semi-final at the Monkart race.
episodes.title: Ellie in Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Jin is told by Bibi that Pixie accepted the seeds of the Aubis given by Petel because he wanted to be strong.
episodes.title: Pixie's Will

episodes.synopsis: The final match of the Monkart race between Jin and Ellie. Draka turns into a megariod. With Jin's victory, Pixie returns to her original form.
episodes.title: Megaroid, Transform!

episodes.synopsis: Jin meets Louie and Lancelot. Louis goes out to defeat the Ghost Rider.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Ghostia Town

episodes.synopsis: Nickel, who studies magic, tries to defeat the Ghost Rider.
episodes.title: The Ghost Rider

episodes.synopsis: Nickel said the Ghost Rider was his dead monster Triki. Jin and Louie play a showdown and decide who will deal with the Ghost Rider.
episodes.title: A Knight's Duty

episodes.synopsis: Triki on the circuit. Nickel sheds tears of emotion as Triki is alive. Draka, Lancelot and Triki join forces to compete against the Ghost Rider.
episodes.title: The Return of Trickie

episodes.synopsis: Vade and Dante try to lock up the maze of mist, but Ruth appears and destroys it.
episodes.title: The Fog Maze

episodes.synopsis: Vade and Dante kidnap Sena. Jin plays Monkart race against Vade to rescue Sena.
episodes.title: Ellie's Betrayal

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Draka win against Dante. Players and monsters who have been trapped in the maze of mist get out.
episodes.title: Maze Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Vade and Dante return the pendant to Sena. The Petel that appeared then shows Larken's strength.
episodes.title: Prince of Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Upon arrival at Sky Valley, the Jin group meets Ridine. Jin participates in the Wind Cup.
episodes.title: Where the Wind Blows

episodes.synopsis: Jin loses against Ridine. Ridine is said to use the force of the wind.
episodes.title: Wings of the Wind

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Draka train to be protected by Sylp.
episodes.title: Reading the Wind

episodes.synopsis: Robin got the protect by Sylp. Each participant have a Wind Cup qualifier and the list of finalists made in public.
episodes.title: The White Brothers

episodes.synopsis: The blind girl Dennis is using the power of Aubis. Destro orders Isabel to plant the seed of truth in Draka.
episodes.title: The Girl in the Dark

episodes.synopsis: Berret accepts the seeds of Aubis for Dennis' victory, but with the victory of Jin and Draca, Barret returns to his original state.
episodes.title: Varret's Wish

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Michael face Petel together, but they are troubled by the strength of the Petel.
episodes.title: Evolution Z

episodes.synopsis: In the Wind Cup final, Isabel shoots the seeds of truth at Draka then Draka became violent.
episodes.title: The Seed of Truth

episodes.synopsis: Draka being out of control. But with Lucy's power, she returns Draka to its original state.
episodes.title: At the End of the Rampage

episodes.synopsis: Jin group head to Bambu Town and meet Chen. Kate's disciple, Chen, decides to help Jin.
episodes.title: The Boy of the Bamboo Forest

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Draka train. Isabel, meanwhile, trapped in jail.
episodes.title: Special Training, Again and Again

episodes.synopsis: Draka evolve into Draburst. Jin gets to the master grade and heads to Posca City.
episodes.title: Evolution Z, Draburst!

episodes.synopsis: In Posca City, Jin is reunited with Louis, Michael and Ridine. The Posca Grand Prix will open and the winner will marry Sena.
episodes.title: To Posca Castle

episodes.synopsis: Eight players will compete, and Destro points to Jin against the match. But Jin gets defeat.
episodes.title: The Grand Prix Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Laura are surrounded by Angela and Ravi. Ravi receives the seeds of Aubis and being out of control.
episodes.title: Hearts in Resonance

episodes.synopsis: With Jin's victory, Angela and Ravi return to their original form.
episodes.title: Fire Against Fire

episodes.synopsis: Louis trains by looking at the notes left by his father, but continues to fail to evolve. Meanwhile, Aubis wakes up Boomstar.
episodes.title: Louis' Crisis

episodes.synopsis: Jin and Louie will play the semi-finals. At this time, Destro suddenly starts Boom Star. Louis evolves Lancelot into Lance Arthur and saves Draka
episodes.title: A Knight's Honor

episodes.synopsis: The Jin Group heads to the dungeon to save Isabel. In there, he meets a stone-turned-king and a queen.
episodes.title: Into Posca Castle

episodes.synopsis: A semifinal match between Michael and Petel. Petel wins.
episodes.title: An Epic Race! Vettel vs Michael

episodes.synopsis: Isabel escapes from the dungeon with Kubi. And the final match began.
episodes.title: Into the Final Round of Posca Grand Prix

episodes.synopsis: Aubis forces Larken to open up it's hidden power. Jin barely wins.
episodes.title: The Final Race! Jin vs Vettel

episodes.synopsis: Jin prepare for the final match.
episodes.title: The Title Match

episodes.synopsis: Destro kills Kate. Jin eventually defeat the Caios. At this time, black energy escapes from the Monkart of the Caios and turns into a giant dark dragon.
episodes.title: The Power of Revenge

episodes.synopsis: The Jin group fights against the dark dragon Apolion.
episodes.title: Apollyon the Fall

episodes.synopsis: Jin fights and wins the Apolion and seals the Apolion. The king and queen were released by magic and returned to their original state.
episodes.title: In the Name of the Knight
